item: guards_for_diff picks tests/test_indexer_pin.py when a diff changes an engine file (R510)
summary: The pin test names no engine file, so no rule of the local guards could pick it: A-037 (#1788) deleted functions in src/analytics/equivalence.py, the digest moved, CI went red and the local run had not executed it. guards_for_diff now reads ENGINE_MODULES from engine_identity.py's source (no import), and a branch diff that touches any listed file, a file removed from the list, engine_identity.py, configs/indexer_pin.json or scripts/indexer_pin.py picks the test (deletes count). An unreadable list picks it for any src/ change and says so; a tree without the pin test picks nothing. Verified on the real tree by appending a comment to equivalence.py: the test is listed. Not covered: ENGINE_DATA_GLOBS data files, which the runtime data digest covers, not this pin.
